request.prompt:
Job T02: usp_load_dim_policy. Policy dimension with type-2 history, loaded once per policy snapshot.
Parameters: SnapshotDate=2025-06-30; SnapshotDate=2025-12-31.

Code:
  1 | /*==============================================================================
  2 |   Job      : dw.usp_load_dim_policy
  3 |   Purpose  : Policy dimension for finance, actuarial and broker reporting. One
  4 |              row per version of a policy term, with its product, broker and
  5 |              customer segment. A new version starts whenever the status,
  6 |              broker, annual premium or vehicle registration changes from one
  7 |              policy snapshot to the next (type 2 history).
  8 |   Run by   : POL_SNAPSHOT_LOAD, once per policy snapshot, oldest first:
  9 |              EXEC dw.usp_load_dim_policy @SnapshotDate = '<snapshot date>'
 10 |   Output   : dw.dim_policy. Keeps history, so the procedure never truncates
 11 |              it. Deploying this script recreates the table empty: reload every
 12 |              snapshot in date order afterwards.
 13 |   Author   : MOB
 14 | 
 15 |   Change log
 16 |     2014-02-10  MOB   Initial version, one row per policy (CR-0655)
 17 |     2015-06-22  MOB   Broker name from the broker register (CR-0790)
 18 |     2016-09-05  TF    Direct business reported as broker DIRECT-SALES (CR-0961)
 19 |     2017-03-13  TF    Type 2 history with MERGE, surrogate key policy_sk
 20 |                       (CR-1077)
 21 |     2018-10-01  PH    Vehicle registration tracked for motor (CR-1388)
 22 |     2019-07-15  PH    Customer segment from dw.dim_customer (CR-1610)
 23 |     2020-02-03  TF    Refuse a snapshot older than the last one loaded
 24 |                       (INC-2105)
 25 |     2021-06-14  KB    Logging through etl.usp_log_step (CR-2003)
 26 | ==============================================================================*/
 27 | SET NOCOUNT ON;
 28 | GO
 29 | IF OBJECT_ID(N'dw.dim_policy', N'U') IS NOT NULL
 30 |     DROP TABLE dw.dim_policy;
 31 | 
 32 | CREATE TABLE dw.dim_policy (
 33 |     policy_sk             INT IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL,
 34 |     policy_id             INT            NOT NULL,
 35 |     policy_number         VARCHAR(20)    NOT NULL,
 36 |     customer_id           INT            NOT NULL,
 37 |     customer_segment      CHAR(4)        NULL,
 38 |     product_code          VARCHAR(10)    NOT NULL,
 39 |     product_name          NVARCHAR(60)   NOT NULL,
 40 |     lob_code              VARCHAR(5)     NOT NULL,
 41 |     broker_code           VARCHAR(12)    NOT NULL,
 42 |     broker_name           NVARCHAR(80)   NULL,
 43 |     status                VARCHAR(12)    NOT NULL,
 44 |     inception_date        DATE           NOT NULL,
 45 |     expiry_date           DATE           NOT NULL,
 46 |     cancellation_date     DATE           NULL,
 47 |     annual_premium        DECIMAL(12,2)  NOT NULL,
 48 |     currency              CHAR(3)        NOT NULL,
 49 |     vehicle_reg           VARCHAR(12)    NULL,
 50 |     ncd_years             INT            NULL,
 51 |     valid_from            DATE           NOT NULL,
 52 |     valid_to              DATE           NOT NULL,   -- 9999-12-31 while current
 53 |     is_current            CHAR(1)        NOT NULL,   -- Y / N
 54 |     source_snapshot_date  DATE           NOT NULL,
 55 |     load_ts               DATETIME2(3)   NOT NULL,
 56 |     CONSTRAINT pk_dim_policy PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED (policy_sk)
 57 | );
 58 | 
 59 | CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX ix_dim_policy_policy_id ON dw.dim_policy (policy_id, is_current);
 60 | GO
 61 | CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dw.usp_load_dim_policy
 62 |     @SnapshotDate DATE
 63 | AS
 64 | BEGIN
 65 |     SET NOCOUNT ON;
 66 | 
 67 |     DECLARE @job_name     VARCHAR(128) = 'dw.usp_load_dim_policy',
 68 |             @rows         INT,
 69 |             @closed       INT,
 70 |             @last_loaded  DATE,
 71 |             @err_msg      NVARCHAR(4000),
 72 |             @err_no       INT;
 73 | 
 74 |     BEGIN TRY
 75 |         EXEC etl.usp_log_step @job_name = @job_name, @step_name = 'start', @status = 'STARTED';
 76 | 
 77 |         /* Oldest snapshot first: loading an older snapshot after a newer one
 78 |            would reopen versions that are already closed (INC-2105) */
 79 |         SELECT  @last_loaded = MAX(d.source_snapshot_date)
 80 |         FROM    dw.dim_policy d;
 81 | 
 82 |         IF @SnapshotDate < @last_loaded
 83 |             THROW 50001, 'dw.dim_policy already holds a later policy snapshot', 1;
 84 | 
 85 |         IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#src') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #src;
 86 | 
 87 |         /* 1. This snapshot's policies with product, broker and customer segment */
 88 |         SELECT  p.policy_id,
 89 |                 p.policy_number,
 90 |                 p.customer_id,
 91 |                 c.segment_code                          AS customer_segment,
 92 |                 pr.product_code,
 93 |                 pr.product_name,
 94 |                 pr.lob_code,
 95 |                 ISNULL(p.broker_code, 'DIRECT-SALES')   AS broker_code,
 96 |                 b.broker_name,
 97 |                 p.status,
 98 |                 p.inception_date,
 99 |                 p.expiry_date,
100 |                 p.cancellation_date,
101 |                 p.annual_premium,
102 |                 p.currency,
103 |                 p.vehicle_reg,
104 |                 p.ncd_years
105 |         INTO    #src
106 |         FROM    stg.policy_snapshots p WITH (NOLOCK)
107 |         JOIN    stg.products pr WITH (NOLOCK)
108 |                 ON pr.product_code = p.product_code
109 |         LEFT JOIN stg.brokers b WITH (NOLOCK)
110 |                ON b.broker_code = p.broker_code
111 |         LEFT JOIN dw.dim_customer c WITH (NOLOCK)
112 |                ON c.customer_id = p.customer_id
113 |         WHERE   p.snapshot_date = @SnapshotDate;
114 | 
115 |         SET @rows = @@ROWCOUNT;
116 |         EXEC etl.usp_log_step @job_name = @job_name, @step_name = 'policy snapshot', @status = 'INFO', @rows_affected = @rows;
117 | 
118 |         IF @rows = 0
119 |             THROW 50002, 'No policies found for this snapshot date', 1;
120 | 
121 |         CREATE CLUSTERED INDEX ix_src_policy_id ON #src (policy_id);
122 | 
123 |         BEGIN TRANSACTION;
124 | 
125 |         /* 2. Close the current version of policies whose status, broker, premium
126 |               or vehicle registration has changed since the last snapshot */
127 |         MERGE dw.dim_policy AS tgt
128 |         USING #src AS src
129 |            ON tgt.policy_id = src.policy_id
130 |           AND tgt.is_current = 'Y'
131 |         WHEN MATCHED AND (   ISNULL(src.status, '')        <> ISNULL(tgt.status, '')
132 |                           OR ISNULL(src.broker_code, '')   <> ISNULL(tgt.broker_code, '')
133 |                           OR ISNULL(src.annual_premium, 0) <> ISNULL(tgt.annual_premium, 0)
134 |                           OR ISNULL(src.vehicle_reg, '')   <> ISNULL(tgt.vehicle_reg, ''))
135 |         THEN UPDATE
136 |              SET    tgt.valid_to   = DATEADD(DAY, -1, @SnapshotDate),
137 |                     tgt.is_current = 'N';
138 | 
139 |         SET @closed = @@ROWCOUNT;
140 | 
141 |         /* 3. Open a current version for new policies and for those closed above */
142 |         INSERT INTO dw.dim_policy
143 |                (policy_id, policy_number, customer_id, customer_segment, product_code,
144 |                 product_name, lob_code, broker_code, broker_name, status, inception_date,
145 |                 expiry_date, cancellation_date, annual_premium, currency, vehicle_reg,
146 |                 ncd_years, valid_from, valid_to, is_current, source_snapshot_date, load_ts)
147 |         SELECT  s.policy_id, s.policy_number, s.customer_id, s.customer_segment, s.product_code,
148 |                 s.product_name, s.lob_code, s.broker_code, s.broker_name, s.status,
149 |                 s.inception_date, s.expiry_date, s.cancellation_date, s.annual_premium,
150 |                 s.currency, s.vehicle_reg, s.ncd_years,
151 |                 @SnapshotDate,
152 |                 '9999-12-31',
153 |                 'Y',
154 |                 @SnapshotDate,
155 |                 SYSDATETIME()
156 |         FROM    #src s
157 |         WHERE   NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1
158 |                             FROM   dw.dim_policy d
159 |                             WHERE  d.policy_id = s.policy_id
160 |                               AND  d.is_current = 'Y')
161 |         ORDER BY s.policy_id;
162 | 
163 |         SET @rows = @@ROWCOUNT;
164 | 
165 |         COMMIT TRANSACTION;
166 | 
167 |         EXEC etl.usp_log_step @job_name = @job_name, @step_name = 'versions closed', @status = 'INFO', @rows_affected = @closed;
168 |         EXEC etl.usp_log_step @job_name = @job_name, @step_name = 'versions opened', @status = 'INFO', @rows_affected = @rows;
169 |         EXEC etl.usp_log_step @job_name = @job_name, @step_name = 'end', @status = 'SUCCESS';
170 |     END TRY
171 |     BEGIN CATCH
172 |         IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
173 | 
174 |         SELECT  @err_msg = ERROR_MESSAGE(),
175 |                 @err_no  = ERROR_NUMBER();
176 | 
177 |         EXEC etl.usp_log_step @job_name = @job_name, @step_name = 'end', @status = 'FAILED',
178 |              @message = @err_msg, @error_number = @err_no;
179 |         THROW;
180 |     END CATCH
181 | END;
182 | GO

request.system_prompt:
You are the defect reviewer agent of LANSH, a factory that migrates legacy T-SQL (SQL Server 2022) jobs to PySpark. LANSH reproduces every legacy behaviour exactly, bugs included, and asks a person to decide what to do about each suspected bug, so finding them matters.

Read the job and list the places where the code most likely does not do what its author intended: wrong comparisons or boundaries, joins that multiply rows, gaps or overlaps in bands, wrong date columns, missing values handled wrongly, truncation, hard-coded constants that should vary. Ignore style, performance and things that are merely unusual. For each, write one Spark SQL SELECT over the views listed that measures the impact on the legacy output: it must return exactly one row with rows_affected (the output rows the bug changes) and, when the bug changes an amount, amount_affected (the total change, positive). Compare what the legacy output holds with what the intended logic would give. Use only the views and columns listed.

defects.description: #src is built from stg.policy_snapshots joined to stg.products, stg.brokers and dw.dim_customer, and nothing makes it unique per policy_id. If a staging table has a duplicate key (the _row_seq column suggests re-staged rows), or a policy appears twice in one snapshot, #src gets several rows for the policy. The INSERT's NOT EXISTS check only looks at rows already in the table, so every duplicate is opened as another current version (is_current='Y'), which counts its annual_premium twice. On a later snapshot those duplicates can also make the MERGE fail because it tries to update the same target row more than once.
defects.impact_query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS rows_affected, COALESCE(SUM(annual_premium), 0) AS amount_affected FROM (SELECT g.annual_premium, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY g.policy_id, g.source_snapshot_date ORDER BY g.policy_sk) AS rn FROM golden_dw_dim_policy g) x WHERE rn > 1
defects.intended_behaviour: Exactly one current version per policy_id per snapshot: each lookup returns at most one row per key, and the snapshot is reduced to one row per policy_id (for example the latest _row_seq) before the MERGE/INSERT.
defects.title: Row-multiplying joins / duplicate snapshot rows create duplicate current versions

defects.description: The MERGE only has a WHEN MATCHED branch. A policy that is in dim_policy but missing from the new snapshot (lapsed, purged or moved out) keeps is_current='Y' and valid_to=9999-12-31 for ever, so it is still reported as a live current policy.
defects.impact_query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS rows_affected, COALESCE(SUM(g.annual_premium), 0) AS amount_affected FROM golden_dw_dim_policy g WHERE g.is_current = 'Y' AND g.source_snapshot_date < DATE'2025-12-31' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM stg_policy_snapshots s WHERE s.snapshot_date = DATE'2025-12-31' AND s.policy_id = g.policy_id)
defects.intended_behaviour: Close the current version (valid_to = snapshot date - 1, is_current = 'N') when a policy no longer appears in the snapshot, for example with WHEN NOT MATCHED BY SOURCE AND tgt.is_current = 'Y'.
defects.title: Policies missing from a later snapshot are never closed

defects.description: stg.products is joined with an INNER JOIN. Any policy whose product_code is missing from the product register is left out of #src with no warning, so it never gets a dimension row, or is never versioned if it already has one.
defects.impact_query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS rows_affected, COALESCE(SUM(annual_premium), 0) AS amount_affected FROM (SELECT DISTINCT p.snapshot_date, p.policy_id, p.annual_premium FROM stg_policy_snapshots p WHERE p.snapshot_date IN (DATE'2025-06-30', DATE'2025-12-31') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM stg_products pr WHERE upper(rtrim(pr.product_code)) = upper(rtrim(p.product_code)))) x
defects.intended_behaviour: Keep every policy in the snapshot (LEFT JOIN with a default or unknown product) or reject/log the unmatched rows. The dimension is meant to hold every policy term.
defects.title: Inner join to stg.products silently drops policies with an unknown product

defects.description: A NULL broker_code is replaced with 'DIRECT-SALES' in the output (line 95), but the broker lookup joins on the original p.broker_code (NULL), so broker_name is always NULL for direct business, even when the broker register has a DIRECT-SALES entry.
defects.impact_query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS rows_affected FROM golden_dw_dim_policy g WHERE g.broker_code = 'DIRECT-SALES' AND g.broker_name IS NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM stg_brokers b WHERE upper(rtrim(b.broker_code)) = 'DIRECT-SALES' AND b.broker_name IS NOT NULL)
defects.intended_behaviour: Join stg.brokers on ISNULL(p.broker_code, 'DIRECT-SALES') so direct business gets the DIRECT-SALES broker name.
defects.title: Direct business never gets a broker name
